$comment: Jetcaster's Wear OS tier as its own sticker sheet. Wear is a separate design system — androidx.wear.compose.material3, round device frames, and its own layout idioms — so it gets a separate catalog rather than being folded into the phone sheet. compareWith pairs it against the phone catalog so the same feature can be read across form factors. NOTE: every preview here is annotated with @WearPreviewDevices/@WearPreviewFontScales, which are multipreview annotations from androidx.wear.compose.ui.tooling.preview — an external artifact. The build-free spec validator only recognises annotations it can see in the scanned source, so it must be run as: validate-catalog-spec.mjs --spec catalog.wear.spec.json --preview-annotation WearPreviewDevices --preview-annotation WearPreviewFontScales. Without those flags it reports 0 discovered previews and fails every entry.
